scope: Post-hoc retrospective reference exercise on the already examined Inteco dataset. Hold original fitting, validation, and seven-record replay roles fixed. Choose within each family/axis on validation only, pooling all six validation ages and both noise levels with drive/low-motion balance. No independent test or hardware latency inference.
observation_variance: Encoder increment squared / 12, fixed across clean and jittered inputs. No jitter condition label enters inference.
